name: 見積りのゼロ点・拡張範囲・未見積りルール
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0079 three supplementary estimation rules ONLY. Original full/crop images1/2 primary controls/states/proportions/strokes/semantics; image3 secondary Japanese wording. Pure-white compact logical812x283 rounded12 white card, fine neutral border,20px padding, three rows and two thin inset dividers. Do not include parent method selector or page title.
Each row has left title Regular14/24 near-black and helper Regular12/16 muted gray, right original small switch38x24, vertically centered on row. Complete exact Japanese:
ROW1「0点の見積りを許可」
「0点で見積れるようにします。親の作業を合計に含めない場合などに使います。」
Switch OFF: neutral gray track, white thumb LEFT.
ROW2「見積りの範囲を拡張」
「見積りの範囲を広げます。大きな作業は小さく分けることを推奨します。」
Switch ON: white thumb RIGHT, forest gradient track #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E.
ROW3「未見積りの作業を数える」
「有効な場合は未見積りを1点、無効な場合は0点として数えます。」
Switch ON: same white thumb RIGHT/forest gradient track.
Fit all text fully in rows, wrapping helper within available width; third line visible completely. Compact original spacing and thin stroke anatomy; no bold row titles, new icons, extraneous settings, broad mint or gray canvas. The zero/one rules and off/on/on distinction must be unmistakable.
reviewNotes: Three complete Japanese rule/helper pairs and original off/on/on thumb states inspected. Active switches use forest accent; neutral white card/dividers. Exact typography/control geometry and policy runtime unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
